brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Dozeline, the iOS and Android wind-down and sleep journal app in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm, warm, not clinical, no moons or stars cliché. The app icon must be recognisable on a home screen at small sizes. English and Turkish markets.

claim.notes: No concept passed the critic gate after two rounds (settle scored 6.23 then 5.92; dimmer and lid were dropped at sketch review), so nothing was finalized, exported or installed.

concepts.title: Dimmer
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: a1 rounded blob/UI tile; a2 barcode or pill toggle; a3 slashed circle (prohibited sign); a4 striped retro sun/no-entry. All generic cut-disc moves, none says dimming or sleep. Try a different move: a graded sequence (e.g. one form in steps of lightness/size) rather than cuts through a disc.

concepts.title: Lid
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: a1 hamburger/bun or sunset; a2 pill box or clapperboard; a3 Stonehenge/trousers; a4 door/arch UI icon. Pictograms of objects, all cliche or confusing at 32px. Try a different move: abstract the closing gesture into one bold shape, not a depicted object.

concepts.title: Settle
readsAs: the letters 'I / _' or 'IL' typed as a slash and underscore
a bar chart or progress/sort glyph
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 three ovals/dots, generic; s8 person/pawn/keyhole; s9 fat curl easing into a flat tail (hook/cane risk at 16px). Only s9 has an ownable silhouette and a real idea (loosening toward rest, no moon). Develop: enlarge the curl so it holds at 32px, thicken the tail, keep terminal round, check it does not read as a hook, pipe or snail, tune the curl-to-tail taper, optical weight balance in the square.
